# infinite-canvas attribution

This isolated workstation entry vendors source code from
[`basketikun/infinite-canvas`](https://github.com/basketikun/infinite-canvas),
revision `a2576d559ad765ba83e9563894adfbcd4e63405a` (v0.15.1).

The upstream project is distributed under the MIT License. The unmodified
license text is preserved in this directory as `LICENSE`.

CanvasMind integration changes are limited to the import alias, hash-based
routing, the isolated HTML entry, and the `/infinite-canvas-workbench` host
route used to open it.
